items.name: Foam rollers
items.about: Unlocks mobility and foam rolling, the only exercise that trains Recovery and removes fatigue.

items.name: Heart-rate monitor
items.about: Shows the exact energy value and heart rate during sessions, so amber is never a guess.

items.name: Rowing machine
items.about: Unlocks rowing: low-impact Endurance work with little fatigue.

items.name: Treadmill
items.about: Runs go ahead at full value in bad weather, and the pace display widens the Perfect band in pace coaching.

items.name: Barbell and rack
items.about: Unlocks the barbell back squat for heavier Strength work.

items.name: Running track membership
items.about: Intervals on a measured track count at full value instead of 80% on the road loop.

items.name: Shed extension
items.about: +3 equipment slots now, so foam rollers, the rowing machine, the treadmill and the barbell can all fit. Also +2 client capacity for later seasons (this season has only Jordan and Peg).
